name: New Member Welcome
response:
Dear {{ first_name }},

Welcome to our church family! We are thrilled to have you as a member of our congregation.

Our pastor or one of our deacons will reach out to you shortly. In the meantime, please don't hesitate to contact us with any questions or needs.

"So then you are no longer strangers and aliens, but you are fellow citizens with the saints and members of the household of God." - Ephesians 2:19

In Christ,
The Pastoral Team
subject: Welcome to Our Church Family!
